title: Compliance Analyst
description:
About Crown

We exist to make money work better. That means eliminating the friction of integrating the Brazilian Real into the blockchain economy without sacrificing trust, safety, or compliance.

With the conviction that programmable money is the future of finance, we built BRLV . Anchored by a 1:1 backing of sovereign Brazilian treasury assets, BRLV is the safe, scalable settlement layer designed for the tokenized economy.

We’re backed by Framework, Valor, Norte, Coinbase Ventures, Paxos, and Nubank co‑founder Ed Wible. Our goal: R$1 trillion of BRLV in circulation within 10 years.

The Role

As a Compliance Analyst at Crown, you will be a cornerstone of our risk management framework, operating across both the first and second lines of defense. You will serve as the primary compliance liaison for our institutional clients and partners, guiding them through our rigorous due diligence process while performing critical risk analysis to protect the firm. This role requires a unique blend of client‑facing communication skills and deep analytical rigor. You will work directly with the Chief Compliance Officer and the broader risk function to implement and uphold our institutional‑grade AML/CFT Policy.

  • Institutional Onboarding (1st Line): Act as the main point of contact for institutional clients during the entire onboarding lifecycle. You will guide them through the appropriate Due Diligence Questionnaire (for Brazilian, U.S., or other non‑U.S. entities), ensuring all mandatory documentation—such as constitutional documents, AML/CFT policies, and ownership charts—is collected completely and accurately.
  • Customer Due Diligence (CDD) and Risk Assessment (2nd Line): Conduct comprehensive reviews of prospective clients, applying our risk‑based approach. This includes analyzing complex corporate structures to identify and verify Ultimate Beneficial Owners (UBOs) according to our dynamic thresholds.
  • Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD): Execute enhanced due diligence for high‑risk clients, including Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs), VASPs, and other financial institutions. This involves a critical assessment of the client’s own AML program, their independent audit reports, and the source of their funds and wealth.
  • Transaction Monitoring Support (2nd Line): Assist in the analysis of alerts generated by our on‑chain and fiat transaction monitoring systems. You will investigate atypical activity, adhering to strict internal SLAs for resolution (e.g., 24 hours for critical alerts), and prepare dossiers for potential Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) to be submitted to COAF.
  • Record Keeping and Data Protection: Ensure all due diligence, risk assessments, and client communications are meticulously documented and securely stored, in compliance with our policies and regulatory requirements. You will handle highly sensitive client data and must adhere strictly to our Information Security Policy and data protection principles (LGPD).

You Might Be a Fit If...

  • You have 3+ years of experience in a compliance, KYC/AML, risk, or client onboarding role within a VASP, fintech, or regulated financial institution.
  • You have a deep and practical understanding of Brazilian AML/CFT regulations (e.g., Law 14.478/22, COAF reporting) and are familiar with international FATF standards.
  • You are fluent in both Portuguese and English, with exceptional written and verbal communication skills required to interact with sophisticated institutional clients and internal stakeholders.
  • You have a highly analytical mindset and an obsessive attention to detail, capable of dissecting complex legal and corporate structures to identify underlying risks.
  • You thrive in ownership-driven environments. You’re highly accountable for your work and don’t require others following up on it.
  • You naturally operate cross-functionally, with strong collaborative instincts toward legal, operations, and technology teams.
  • You are energized by the challenge of building and refining compliance processes from the ground up in a fast-paced environment.

What’s Different About Working Here

  • Small by design. We don’t hire layers of managers. Everyone builds.
  • Ownership is total. You own the function end‑to‑end—and ask for input when it makes the work better, not because someone’s checking.
  • Ruthlessly simple. We don’t paper over complexity with process or headcount.
  • Collaboration is default. Problems are shared property. We work across domains.
  • Feedback is candid and direct. Built on the assumption that everyone here is smart, competent, and cares.

Compensation

  • Competitive salary
  • Full health coverage
  • VA

description:

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world's leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million and in line to exceed US$200 million in FY25, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL's evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.

Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator ("MVNO") in ten countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 450 experts across 15 countries.

Position Overview

1Global is seeking a talented and detail-oriented RoamingIREG Engineer to manage the entire roaming process and procedures. As an IREG Engineer you will be responsible for the technical setup, testing, and maintenance of international roaming and interconnect services.

We're looking for a proactive individual with a strong technical foundation, adept at troubleshooting support cases and enhancing operational processes for seamless footprint updates.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and document IREG tests (IR.24, IR.35, IR.50, etc.) for voice, SMS, and data services, in line with GSMA standards
  • Set up and verify interconnect links for voice and messaging services with partner operators
  • Monitor roaming service KPIs, troubleshoot issues, and ensure compliance with roaming agreements
  • Configure and test SS7, Diameter, SIP, and related signaling protocols for international connectivity
  • Liaise with foreign operators, roaming hubs, and internal teams during implementation and troubleshooting
  • Maintain up-to-date test results, network configurations, and operational procedures
  • Oversee the footprint management of all 1Global products, working closely with the wholesale and other networks team

Requirements

Must Have

  • Perform end-to-end roaming testing (voice, SMS, data, CAMEL, VoLTE, 5G roaming)
  • Execute IREG test cases according to GSMA guidelines and bilateral agreements
  • Analyze and troubleshoot roaming issues with signaling traces and logs
  • Work closely with international roaming partners to resolve interconnect problems
  • Manage and update roaming documentation (IR.21)
  • Support new roaming launches (testing and activation of new operators, technologies, and services)
  • Coordinate with internal teams (Core Network, Billing, etc) during testing and troubleshooting
  • Validate TAP files and charging/billing aspects of roaming services
  • Monitor KPIs and performance of roaming services after launch
  • Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators for the entire roaming service
  • Close relationship with external partners like carriers, service providers
  • Have successful partnerships with other departments and teams

Qualifications

  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, ETSI, standards and specifications for SIM/eSIM
  • Knowledge and experience with protocols such as MAP, S6a
  • Familiar with an RSP architecture and experience operating it
  • Knowledge in scripting and have basic programming skills
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot network errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape

Benefits

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses — to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

title: Document Controller
description:
Advert 2H Offshore is a global engineering contractor specializing in the design, engineering and integrity management of offshore structures, topsides facilities, subsea components and riser and conductor systems for the offshore oil and gas and renewables sectors. Both market sectors require similar engineering skill sets, and our breadth of experience in offshore structures and environments allows us to provide expertise at all stages of a project: feasibility and concept design, detailed design, procurement management, fabrication support, installation support, monitoring, integrity management, asset life extension and decommissioning.
2H Offshore is seeking an experienced Document Controller to join our team and support large-scale subsea engineering projects. The ideal candidate will take ownership of document control processes, ensuring compliance with internal standards and client requirements. This is not an administrative role—we need someone with proven expertise in document management systems, document lifecycle workflows, and quality assurance protocols, who can proactively support project teams and contribute to efficient project execution.
The successful candidate will be based in the Rio de Janeiro area.
**Please submit Resumes/CVs in English.
Duties
•Implement and manage document control procedures aligned with company and client standards
•Maintain accurate records of incoming and outgoing documentation, including engineering deliverables, technical reports, and correspondence
•Ensure version control, document traceability, and appropriate metadata tagging across all project files
•Coordinate with engineering, procurement, project management, and external stakeholders to manage document workflows and approvals
•Monitor document deadlines and ensure timely distribution of critical information
•Conduct regular audits to verify compliance and data integrity
•Train team members on document control systems and best practices as required
•Interface with client document control systems, ensuring consistency and alignment
•Support preparation of project handovers, final documentation, and close-out packages
Required
•Proven experience as a document controller in the oil & gas or offshore engineering sector, ideally with exposure to subsea projects
•Strong understanding of document control standards, numbering systems, and ISO-based procedures
•Proficiency in document management platforms (e.g., SharePoint, Aconex, OpenText, or client-specific DMS)
•Strong communication skills in English
•Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills
•Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, technical environment
•Familiarity with engineering terminology and project documentation (e.g., drawings, MTOs, technical specs)
•Degree or diploma in engineering, administration, or related field is preferred

title: Email Marketing Associate
description:
Join to apply for the Email Marketing Associate role at Darkroom .

About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. Founded in 2017 out of a conviction that iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different, Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results‑driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and earned esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We are hiring an Email Marketing Specialist – a sharp, creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, conversion, and customer retention. This is not a plug‑and‑play execution role; it requires a high level of ownership, creative problem‑solving, and a strong grasp of lifecycle marketing strategy. You’ll partner closely with Retention Managers and designers to develop and deploy high‑performing email and SMS campaigns for some of the fastest‑growing DTC brands in the world. From ideation and copywriting to QA and reporting, you'll be hands‑on throughout the lifecycle, translating insights into messages that drive revenue, deepen loyalty, and elevate the customer experience.

Darkroom is a career accelerator for marketers who want to operate at the intersection of creativity, commerce, and performance while mastering the tools and tactics of modern CRM strategy.

Fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Argentina, Colombia and Mexico.

A Day in the Life

  • Work directly with a Retention Marketing Manager to execute data‑driven email and SMS strategies for our DTC/e‑commerce clients.
  • On a daily basis, you will execute tasks for clients including writing, proofing, and scheduling email and SMS campaigns.
  • You’ll work directly with clients to manage the revision and approval process of their emails and SMS messages.
  • On a monthly basis, you’ll develop creative campaign concepts for your client's retention marketing calendars.
  • You’ll work directly with our in‑house design team to develop the design approach, ensuring the design vision for campaigns and flows comes to life, and managing the revision and approval process for client emails.
  • You’ll produce the copy for your campaign concepts and work directly with the client to gain approval on briefs before sending them to our in‑house designers.
  • Driven and enjoy coming to the team and clients with new retention marketing ideas.
  • Execute automation/flow logic set‑up, pop-up builds, and app integrations.

Who You Are

We're looking for an Email Marketing Specialist to join our team! In this role, you will write email and SMS marketing copy, build and deploy email and SMS flows and campaigns, and develop content for our e‑commerce, DTC clients.

  • You’re passionate about developing creative email and SMS marketing copy that drives loyalty and lifetime value for e‑commerce clients.
  • You have experience working in Klaviyo or a similar ESP.
  • You’re passionate about marketing, and especially interested in learning and growing in the DTC and e‑commerce marketing industry.
  • You’re a creative and experienced writer and looking to grow your career in marketing copywriting.
  • You're used to working in a fast‑paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.
  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.

You Should Apply If This Sounds Like You

  • 2‑4 years of work experience in digital marketing, copywriting, growth marketing, e‑commerce, etc.
  • Past experience working at an agency or working with multiple clients in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Experience working with Klaviyo or similar email service providers.
  • Enthusiastic, passionate, and creative; thrives on thinking outside the box to create new best‑in‑class customer experiences.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus the ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. With hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, São Paulo, and Barcelona!
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

O vendedor é um profissional com olhar direcionado para o cliente identificando suas necessidades e capacidade de compra, de modo que atenda às necessidades do ponto de venda.

Identificar novos clientes para prospecção na área de varejo do segmento alimentício, conforme perfil estabelecido, aumentando a capilaridade da companhia.

Analisar o desempenho de sua carteira de clientes com base nos indicadores propostos pela empresa e tomar medidas de melhoria.

Capturar informações relevantes sobre mercado e concorrência, para alimentar a supervisão.

Requisitos: Nível médio, técnicas de vendas e conhecimentos do pacote office.

Escuta Ativa, Comunicação Assertiva, Negociação, Raciocínio Lógico

description:
Field Compliance Coordinator - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package

Position : Field Compliance Coordinator with full relocation to Saudi Arabia as a permanent full‑time expatriate. Attractive relocation package. Qualified candidates will be contacted.

Position Description

We are seeking a Field Compliance Coordinator to join our Upstream OE & Compliance Division. The Division is responsible for providing safety support to Upstream Executive Management and various organizations through HSE reporting, safety audits, recommendations, human‑factor guidance, training, major incident investigations, and lessons‑learned creation. Your primary role will support upstream organizations on Process Safety and major incident investigations for onshore and offshore drilling and oil & gas processing plants.

Key Responsibilities

  • Enhance safety standards and procedures such as work permits, process safety, hazard identification, risk management, and emergency preparedness.
  • Develop loss‑prevention, fire‑prevention, and safety standards, procedures, and General Instructions (GIs) for matters not covered by existing resources.
  • Consult with upstream management to facilitate Safety Management System (SMS) enhancement.
  • Create critical safety documents for major activities such as job safety analyses and hazard identification plans.
  • Assist departments in preparing for major safety reviews, including loss‑prevention compliance reviews.
  • Research emerging safety technologies and conduct feasibility studies and cost analyses to identify improved solutions for existing safety problems and regulatory requirements.
  • Act as a process‑safety audit expert during design, construction, commissioning, turnover to operations, ongoing operations, change management, and decommissioning.
  • Develop and deliver safety training material and safe‑work procedures to field personnel.
  • Instruct on safety concepts, practices, and standards (both on‑the‑job and classroom).
  • Direct and participate in preparing major reference manuals documenting corporate and LP safety systems, policies, and procedures (e.g., LP Policy, SMS manual, Safety Handbook, Construction Safety Manual).
  • Facilitate and lead incident investigations, including interviewing witnesses, gathering data, and conducting root‑cause analysis.
  • Facilitate and lead safety audits by identifying non‑compliance with occupational health and safety regulations and advising on improvements.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, HSE, or an equivalent accredited program.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in upstream organizations spanning exploration, drilling, and production on both onshore and offshore sites, with at least 5 years in a senior loss‑prevention or fire‑prevention role.
  • Strong technical expertise in process safety disciplines such as design engineering, loss control management, hazard identification, HAZOP reviews, incident investigations, emergency preparedness, response, and safety management systems.
  • Experience with HAZOP and SIL studies is preferred; internationally recognized certifications are advantageous.

Working Environment

Our high‑performing employees are drawn by challenging and rewarding professional, technical, and industrial opportunities, and are remunerated accordingly.

Benefits

Permanent expatriate relocation package, competitive compensation, and opportunities for career development within a global energy leader.

  • Consegue segurar plantão e dar suporte ao time como referência técnica.
